title: One Bomb's Shockwave Circled the Earth Three Times

scenes.text: One bomb's shockwave circled the Earth three times.
In 1961, the Soviet Union tested the Tsar Bomba. It blasted 50 megatons.
The fireball was five miles wide. Windows shattered more than 400 miles away.
That's about 1,500 times the Hiroshima and Nagasaki bombs combined.
The shockwave went around the planet three times. The first lap took 36 hours.
Three full laps around the whole Earth.

description:
The Tsar Bomba, tested in 1961, is the most powerful bomb ever detonated.
Its blast was 50 megatons and its shockwave circled the Earth three times.
The first lap took 36 hours and 27 minutes.
What other force on Earth can reach that far?
first_comment: Which historical event do you think left the biggest mark on Earth?
